name: com.dronecv.flight
description: Two tools in one package. (1) GIS Environment Builder: an Editor window (DroneCV > GIS Environment Builder…) that generates a real-world 3D area via the dronecv Python pipeline (auto-installed), imports terrain+buildings+trees directly into the scene, exports to OBJ/glTF/Prefab/FBX, and can merge a district into one object+material. (2) Simulation bridge and mock sensors that speak the dronecv wire protocol v1.0 over TCP; the Python side cannot tell this bridge apart from the headless simulator.
